notes.title: Release date postponed
notes.notes:
We are terribly sorry but we were forced to postpone release date of Wacky Chariots in Early Access by one month to the 22nd of July 2022 due to persistent technical difficulties. 

Even through more functions will be added/modified during Early Access we still want to improve existing functions and provide better initial experience from our game. 

Follow us on our social networks for more information 

Yours Ostrichsoft

notes.title: Wacky Chariots Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
We sincerely apologize but release date of Wacky Chariots will be postponed to the 22nd of June 2022. 

Due to our planned attendance to Indie Showcase during Game Access Conference in Brno we had to divert lots of our resources for preparations for the event. If you are also attending this event, we would be more than delighted to see you there, so come visit us at our table. 

Follow us for more updates in the meantime.
